name: Sarah's Circuit
description: A retro neon circuit board. Trace copper paths through IC blocks to activate all 10 data nodes. The chips won't let you cut corners.

messages.welcome: System boot initiated. Navigate the circuit board to activate all 10 data nodes!
messages.supercharger_charge: Capacitor bank! Energy restored to maximum!
messages.victory: All %d data nodes activated. System boot complete!
messages.stranded: No power remaining. Dead in the circuit.
messages.hit_wall: Crashed into an IC block! Circuit damaged.
